profile.headline: Software Engineer ♥ Abbott Diabetes Care
profile.summary: Hello! I am a recent graduate in the medical devices industry at Abbott Laboratories. This role at in the Diabetes Care department allowed me to greatly strengthen my skills in cloud software engineering. I also love collaboration and connecting with others!

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
∠ Created system using existing reinforcement learning tools to generate a network of possible cyber attack paths on that network.
∠Wrote and consolidated documentation for the system, including error handling.
positions.insights: Skills: Reinforcement Learning · Machine Learning · Data Science

positions.title: Firmware Co-Op
positions.description: Designed and implemented APIs for internal use for the ASIC chip.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer Co-Op
positions.description:
Tested boards, analyzed results, and made conclusions about the state of machines.
Created testing solutions and wrote scripts to test the integrity of memory  and its impact on the firmware.
Improved efficiency of tests used on firmware by 30 percent.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Facilitated lessons on engineering fundamentals, LabView, python, and spatial thinking.
Peer mentor for freshman engineering students and enforced good study and living habits for college life.
Analyzed student project and examination performance to create a more suitable lesson/study plan.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutored student in math and reading and tracked their progress to identify opportunities to alter teaching methods to help students achieve their academic goals

volunteerExperiences.description: Organized virtual robotics competition on a small team for elementary students at Cincinnati Public School. Contacted schools and robotics software creators, as well as organized all challenges and competitions. Several students were more interested in STEM as a result.
